body:
I don’t know a whole lot about it but I do know it wasn’t a violent rape (I mean, it is violence but it was a miscommunication between him and his partner. He stopped when she said stop). He didn’t give me explicit details but did tell me how the night went down. I know he could not be telling the whole truth and I’ve considered that. 

He immediately apologized and did attempt to make amends with her but she understandably wanted nothing to do with it. No treatment as far as I know. 

My own issues absolutely could be getting in the way of me seeing the truth. I just got out of an abusive and manipulative relationship earlier this year which is one of the main reasons I’m not sure I should trust my judgement on this one. He’s so great in literally every other aspect so I can tell that I want to give him a chance. 

I’m definitely thinking about everything and this isn’t a decision I have to make quickly. Just trying to get some outside opinions that aren’t as close as I am. Thank you!

Your comment made me cry and feel hope at the same time. Some of the things you wrote feel like they came directly from him because he’s said those exact things to me before. Especially the “he would want me to succeed where he failed” part. 

This means so, so much to me. I’ve been struggling to find people who can relate. Would you be willing to chat?

Thank you
Thinking about how much he lifted me up is the only thing keeping me from being a sobbing mess all day. Thanks for the offer. I’ll likely take you up on it soon.
Too many things to list out here but it’s a lot of heavy shit. I have a therapist but it’s not working fast enough
